text:
lina: Kickoff: publishing py/ts SDKs in the 02:00 UTC change window. Expect registry rate limits and token churn. I'll coordinate pin + stagger. @aditya can you own the registry sidecar?
aditya: On it. I'll pre-warm creds and add dist-tag scripts. Plan: cohorts of 50 packages every 3 min.
maya: Changelog finalization: pushed last edits to https://redwood/release/350512 — please review before cut.
sam: If we hit failures, prefer pinback to rollback. Keep `latest` untouched until cohort 4.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: publish sequence started (cohort 1/4). packages=48, queue=0
lina: Make sure publish scripts include checksum verification: `sha256sum *.whl` and `npm pack --dry-run`.
alex: Rollback criteria proposal: >5% publish failures or >3 downstream install errors within 15m => pause + pinback. +1?
maya: Agree. Also add a changelog note for the TS breaking typing tweak.
devex-bot: devex-bot: Reminder — change window quiet period between 02:10–02:30 UTC.
aditya: If registry spikes, we'll slow down cohorts and switch to token pool B (`ROTATE_TOKEN_B=true`).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: cohort 2/4 completed. cohort 3 pending. failures=1 (retrying 1/48).
sam: Observed npm install flakiness on internal CI after cohort 2. Recommend halting cohort 3 for 2m while we validate.
lina: Halting cohort 3. Pinback plan in place: to pin we run `npm dist-tag add package@<prev> latest` and `twine upload --repository-url ... --skip-existing` to reassign.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: cohort 3 paused by lina at 02:12:40 UTC. status=paused
aditya: I'll run smoke installs against the canary registry mirror and report in 3m.
maya: I've updated release notes with rollback rationale and deprecation lines for legacy sync client.
alex: If canary mirror passes, resume cohort 3 but keep cohort size to 20 pkgs/min for safety.
aditya: Smoke installs OK on mirror. latency normal. ready to resume.
lina: Resuming cohort 3 with throttled rate. document the pinback command in release notes (done).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: resumed cohort 3/4. rate=20/min. failures=0
sam: :thumbsup: good catch. After full rollout, we'll open a postmortem if any instability persists.
lina: Final note: tag release with `git tag -a v1.12.0 -m 'release notes' && git push --tags` and publish release notes. Thanks team. :party_parrot:
